/**
 * Open-access papers for a query, only those OpenAlex holds a PDF copy of (its content API
 * fetched 10/10 of them in S00, where publisher links managed 2/20).
 */
export async function searchWorks(query: string, perPage = 15): Promise<FoundWork[]> {
  const filter = "open_access.is_oa:true,has_content.pdf:true,type:article|preprint|review"
  const page = await openAlex<{ results: SearchWork[] }>(
    `/works?search=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&filter=${filter}&per_page=${perPage}&select=${SELECT},has_content`,
  )
  return (page?.results ?? [])
    .filter((w) => w.display_name && w.has_content?.pdf)
    .map((w) => {
      const csl = toCsl(w)
      return {
        id: w.id.replace("https://openalex.org/", ""),
        doi: w.doi?.replace(/^https?:\/\/doi\.org\//i, "") ?? null,
        title: w.display_name as string,
        year: w.publication_year,
        authors: (w.authorships ?? [])
          .map((a) => a.author?.display_name)
          .filter((n): n is string => Boolean(n))
          .slice(0, 6),
        venue: w.primary_location?.source?.display_name ?? null,
        cited: w.cited_by_count ?? 0,
        abstract: (csl.abstract ?? "").slice(0, 1200),
        csl,
      }
    })
}

/**
 * Papers (OpenAlex, open access with a PDF copy) and Wikipedia articles, deduplicated and
 * without what's already in the library. Each one is reported as it's found.
 */
export async function findSources(
  plan: SearchPlan,
  input: {
    tracer: Tracer
    /** DOIs already in the library, lower case. */
    known: Set<string>
    onFound: (source: FoundSource) => void
    abortSignal?: AbortSignal
  },
): Promise<FoundSource[]> {
  const found = new Map<string, FoundSource>()
  const add = (source: FoundSource) => {
    if (found.has(source.key)) return
    found.set(source.key, source)
    input.onFound(source)
  }
  await Promise.all([
    ...plan.paperQueries.map(async (query) => {
      const started = performance.now()
      const works = await searchWorks(query, 12).catch((error: Error) => {
        input.tracer.log({
          agent: "scout",
          step: "openalex",
          action: "failed",
          detail: { query, message: error.message },
        })
        return []
      })
      input.tracer.log({
        agent: "scout",
        step: "openalex",
        action: "searched_openalex",
        rowsReturned: works.length,
        latencyMs: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
        detail: { query },
      })
      for (const { id, ...work } of works) {
        if (work.doi && input.known.has(work.doi.toLowerCase())) continue
        add({ key: `openalex:${id}`, kind: "paper", workId: id, ...work })
      }
    }),
    searchWeb(plan.webQuery, input.tracer, input.abortSignal)
      .then((pages) => {
        for (const page of pages) add(page)
      })
      .catch((error: Error) => {
        if (error.name === "AbortError") throw error
        input.tracer.log({
          agent: "scout",
          step: "web",
          action: "failed",
          detail: { message: error.message.slice(0, 300) },
        })
      }),
  ])
  return [...found.values()]

/**
 * The PDF OpenAlex keeps of a work (content API, $0.01 each on the key's daily budget). The key
 * goes in a header, never the URL. Null when there's no key or no copy.
 */
export async function openAlexPdf(workId: string): Promise<Uint8Array | null> {
  const key = env.OPENALEX_API_KEY
  if (!key || !/^W\d+$/.test(workId)) return null
  const res = await fetch(`https://content.openalex.org/works/${workId}.pdf`, {
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, "user-agent": INGEST.userAgent },
    redirect: "follow",
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(INGEST.fetchTimeoutMs),
  }).catch(() => null)
  if (!res?.ok) return null
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer())
  // %PDF- magic: a login or error page is not the paper.
  return bytes[0] === 0x25 && bytes[1] === 0x50 && bytes[2] === 0x44 && bytes[3] === 0x46
    ? bytes
    : null
}

/**
 * Finds the published record of a document in OpenAlex: by the DOI printed in it or in its link,
 * then by its arXiv id, then by its title. A title search is accepted only when the titles match
 * closely, so a wrong paper is never attached; no match is a normal outcome.
 */
export async function findMetadata(input: {
  fileName: string
  title?: string
  text: string
  sourceUrl?: string | null
}): Promise<Pick<FileMeta, "csl" | "openalex" | "foundBy"> | null> {
  const head = input.text.slice(0, 8000)
  const found = (work: Work | null, foundBy: FileMeta["foundBy"]) =>
    work?.display_name
      ? {
          csl: toCsl(work),
          openalex: {
            id: work.id.replace("https://openalex.org/", ""),
            citedBy: work.cited_by_count ?? 0,
          },
          foundBy,
        }
      : null

  const doi = (input.sourceUrl?.match(DOI_RE) ?? head.match(DOI_RE))?.[1]?.replace(/[.,;)]+$/, "")
  // arXiv's own DOIs (10.48550/arXiv.<id>) take the arXiv path below, which checks for reposts.
  const arxivDoi = doi?.match(/^10\.48550\/arxiv\.(\d{4}\.\d{4,5})/i)?.[1]
  if (doi && !arxivDoi) {
    const hit = found(await byDoi(doi), "doi")
    if (hit) return hit
  }

  const arxiv =
    arxivDoi ??
    (input.fileName.match(ARXIV_RE) ??
      input.sourceUrl?.match(ARXIV_RE) ??
      head.match(ARXIV_RE))?.[1]
  if (arxiv) {
    // OpenAlex may hold the peer-reviewed version (keep it), or a later repost merged into the
    // arXiv record (wrong year and DOI). Its record is used only when it is the same paper from
    // about the same time; otherwise the arXiv listing is the record.
    const [listing, work] = await Promise.all([
      arxivRecord(arxiv).catch(() => null),
      byDoi(`10.48550/arXiv.${arxiv}`).catch(() => null),
    ])
    const hit = found(work, "arxiv")
    const sameTime =
      listing && hit?.csl
        ? Math.abs((yearOfCsl(hit.csl) ?? 0) - (yearOfCsl(listing) ?? 0)) <= 3 &&
          titleSimilarity(listing.title ?? "", hit.csl.title ?? "") >= 0.85
        : Boolean(hit)
    if (hit && sameTime) return hit
    if (listing) return { csl: listing, foundBy: "arxiv" }
  }

  const title = input.title?.trim()
  if (title && words(title).length >= 4) {
    const res = await openAlex<{ results: Work[] }>(
      `/works?search=${encodeURIComponent(title)}&per-page=3&select=${SELECT}`,
    )

/**
 * The published record (OpenAlex) and a short summary, both best-effort: a file is never held
 * back or failed because a lookup was slow or found nothing. Details the person edited stay.
 */
async function describe(
  file: FileRow,
  result: DocResult,
): Promise<{ meta: FileMeta; title?: string }> {
  const previous = (file.meta ?? {}) as FileMeta
  const text = result.passages.map((p) => p.text).join("\n")
  const isDocument = file.kind !== "audio" && file.kind !== "video" && file.kind !== "youtube"
  const titleHint =
    result.title ?? (looksLikeFileName(file.title) ? openingLines(result.passages) : file.title)
  const [found, summary] = await Promise.all([
    isDocument && previous.foundBy !== "you"
      ? findMetadata({
          fileName: file.title,
          title: titleHint,
          text,
          sourceUrl: file.sourceUrl,
        }).catch((error: Error) => {
          console.warn(`[details] ${file.id} OpenAlex: ${error.message}`)
          return null
        })
      : null,
    summarize(result.title ?? titleHint ?? file.title, text, {
      wantTitle: looksLikeFileName(file.title) && !result.title,
    }).catch((error: Error) => {
      console.warn(`[details] ${file.id} summary: ${error.message}`)
      return {} as { summary?: string; title?: string }
    }),
  ])
  const meta: FileMeta = {
    ...previous,
    ...(found ?? {}),
    summary: summary.summary ?? previous.summary,
  }
  // A file still named by its file name takes the paper's title, else one read from its content.
  const better = found?.csl?.title ?? summary.title
  return { meta, title: better && looksLikeFileName(file.title) ? better : undefined }
}

/**
 * Where a DOI's paper can be read for free, best first: arXiv itself for arXiv DOIs, then every
 * open location OpenAlex knows with a PDF link (its "best" one is sometimes a dead mirror, so the
 * caller tries them in turn). Empty when there is no free copy: Konkyo then says so, instead of
 * saving the publisher's abstract page as "the paper".
 */
export async function openAccessPdfs(doi: string): Promise<string[]> {
  type Location = { pdf_url?: string | null; is_oa?: boolean }
  const arxiv = doi.match(/^10\.48550\/arxiv\.(.+)$/i)?.[1]
  const work = await openAlex<{ best_oa_location?: Location | null; locations?: Location[] }>(
    `/works/doi:${encodeURIComponent(doi.toLowerCase())}?select=best_oa_location,locations`,
  )
  const candidates = [
    arxiv ? `https://arxiv.org/pdf/${arxiv}` : null,
    ...(work?.locations ?? [])
      .filter((l) => l.is_oa && l.pdf_url)
      .map((l) => l.pdf_url as string)
      .sort((a, b) => Number(/arxiv\.org/.test(b)) - Number(/arxiv\.org/.test(a))),
    work?.best_oa_location?.pdf_url ?? null,
  ]
  return [...new Set(candidates.filter((u): u is string => Boolean(u)))]
}

/**
 * A work's open-access licence (an article's page images, plan F57): OpenAlex's best open
 * location. Open means a Creative Commons or public-domain licence; unknown is closed.
 */
export async function openAccessLicence(
  doi: string,
): Promise<{ name: string | null; url: string | null; open: boolean } | null> {
  const work = await openAlex<{
    best_oa_location?: { license?: string | null; landing_page_url?: string | null } | null
  }>(`/works/doi:${encodeURIComponent(doi.toLowerCase())}?select=best_oa_location`).catch(
    () => null,
  )
  if (!work) return null
  const name = work.best_oa_location?.license ?? null
  return {
    name,
    url: work.best_oa_location?.landing_page_url ?? null,
    open: Boolean(name && /^(cc|public-domain)/i.test(name)),
  }
}

async function openAlex<T>(path: string): Promise<T | null> {
  const key = env.OPENALEX_API_KEY
  const res = await fetch(`${OPENALEX}${path}`, {
    headers: {
      "user-agent": INGEST.userAgent,
      // In a header, never the URL: URLs end up in logs.
      ...(key ? { authorization: `Bearer ${key}` } : {}),
    },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(INGEST.metadataTimeoutMs),
  })
  if (res.status === 404) return null
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`OpenAlex answered ${res.status}`)
  // a few OpenAlex records carry double-encoded names and titles: repaired on the way in
  return repairText((await res.json()) as T)
}

/** The same search straight from OpenAlex, when the Zetaris instance won't hold a REST table. */
async function directWorks(topic: string, known: Set<string>): Promise<WatchedWork[]> {
  const key = env.OPENALEX_API_KEY
  const res = await fetch(watchEndpoint(topic), {
    headers: { "user-agent": INGEST.userAgent, ...(key ? { authorization: `Bearer ${key}` } : {}) },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(INGEST.metadataTimeoutMs),
  })
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`OpenAlex answered ${res.status}`)
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
  const body = (await res.json()) as {
    results: {
      id: string
      doi: string | null
      display_name: string | null
      publication_date: string | null
      authorships?: { author?: { display_name?: string } }[]
      primary_location?: { source?: { display_name?: string } | null } | null
    }[]
  }
  return body.results
    .map((r) => ({
      openalexId: r.id.replace("https://openalex.org/", ""),
      doi: (r.doi ?? "").replace(/^https?:\/\/doi\.org\//i, "").toLowerCase(),
      title: r.display_name ?? "Untitled",
      publicationDate: r.publication_date ?? "",
      firstAuthor: r.authorships?.[0]?.author?.display_name ?? null,
      authors: r.authorships?.length ?? 0,
      venue: r.primary_location?.source?.display_name ?? null,
    }))
    .filter((w) => w.doi && w.publicationDate <= today && !known.has(w.doi))
}

/**
 * The OpenAlex search a watch runs (plan F34): papers whose title or abstract match the topic
 * (plain `search=` also matches full text, which let loosely related papers through: checked
 * testing), newest first, open access with a PDF copy so Import can read it, trimmed with
 * `select=` (5–10× faster in Zetaris, S00). Commas would split OpenAlex's filter list.
 */
export const watchEndpoint = (topic: string) =>
  `https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=title_and_abstract.search:${encodeURIComponent(topic.replace(/,/g, " ").trim())},open_access.is_oa:true,has_content.pdf:true,type:article|preprint|review&sort=publication_date:desc&per_page=25&select=${SELECT}`

/**
 * Rate limits (plan §3 "Model calls"). Each model has one token bucket per server process; the web
 * app and the worker each take a share of MODEL_API.requestsPerMinute (MODEL_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE
 * sets it, half each by default). Each person has a cap on answers, so a public guest sign-in
 * can't use up everyone's budget.
 */
export const LIMITS = {
  modelRequestsPerMinute: MODEL_API.requestsPerMinute / 2,
  modelCallsInFlight: 8,
  answersPerTenMinutes: 20,
  guestAnswersPerDay: 60,
  answersPerDay: 300,
  /** Deep searches download papers ($0.01 each from OpenAlex) and search the web. */
  guestDeepSearchesPerDay: 3,
  deepSearchesPerDay: 20,
  /**
   * Every file is read, embedded and checked in Zetaris (and recordings transcribed), so additions
   * are capped too. A guest's 3 deep searches import about 24, which leaves room to upload.
   */
  guestFilesPerDay: 40,
  filesPerDay: 300,
} as const
